# Test fixtures

Byte-exact: `.gitattributes` turns off line-ending conversion here. Acoustic values in these
files are format evidence only, never results to quote.

| Folder | Source |
|---|---|
| `upstream/tutorial1/` | Tutorial 1's SPPS and TCR inputs and its TetGen input. See `PROVENANCE.md` there. |
| `upstream/lib_interface/` | `src/lib_interface/tests/` at upstream `929a5c8`, unmodified: `cube.cbin`, `cube_mesh.mbin`, `rs_cut.csbin`, `test_import1.poly` |
| `upstream/python_bindings/` | `src/python_bindings/tests/` at upstream `929a5c8`, unmodified: `mesh.cbin`, `tetramesh.mbin`, `retrocompat_test.gabe`, `rs_cut.csbin` |
| `solver-outputs/tutorial1/` | Outputs of the **reference** solvers from the M1 gate run `target/gates/m1/20260923-043220` on the tutorial 1 fixture. `spps_50hz.pbin` comes from our M1 build, rerun on the same fixture with `nbparticules_rendu="20"` so it exports particles. |
| `solver-outputs/nightmode-2026-09-08/` | Night Mode's valid corrected-hall run (`build-clean/sim_output/`, 2026-09-08): the SPPS stats GABE, TCR `Main results.gabe`, and the TCR mesh's `model_skipped.face/.node` (a failed TetGen run, kept as a negative case) |
| `rooms/` | Ten rooms. The two reference rooms, imported by `simpa import-proj` from upstream's own tutorials: `tutorial1_box.simpa` (`tutorial_1.proj`) and `elmia_corrected.simpa` (`tutorial_2.proj`, groups from its `.finfo` files). These replace Night Mode's `testdata/elmia_corrected.ply`, which has 2,438 of its 7,860 faces in the wrong group. Three rooms derived from them for the M5/M6 gates: `tutorial1_box_seeded.simpa`, `tutorial1_box_fitting.simpa` and `elmia_loss_gate.simpa`; five for M7: `level_box_20m.simpa`, `seats_box.simpa`, `energetic_box.simpa`, `sources2_box.simpa` and `tutorial1_box_asymmetric.simpa`. See `rooms/PROVENANCE.md`. |
| `results/` | Four run folders as `simpa run` wrote them: SPPS and TCR on `rooms/seats_box.simpa`, whose point receivers are `Seat` and `Seat2` (gate M7(e)), and SPPS on `rooms/energetic_box.simpa` and `rooms/sources2_box.simpa` (the M7 review's energetic mode and echograms per source). See `results/PROVENANCE.md`. |
| `meshes/broken_hall/` | The raw hall's failed TetGen set from Night Mode's `build-clean/sim_output/tcr/` (2026-09-08): `model.poly`, the partial `model.1.{node,ele,face}`, `model_skipped.{face,node}` (535 skipped facets), no `.1.neigh`, and the `tetramesh.mbin` and `model.cbin` TCR then solved on. This is arc item 12's mesh. See `PROVENANCE.md` there. |
| `meshes/tg_bad/` | The contract survey's self-intersecting cube: upstream's TetGen stopped with skipped facet markers 8, 9 and 12 and no `.1.neigh`. Includes `mkpolybad.py`'s `.poly`, the partial `.1.*`, `_skipped.*` and `tg.stdout`. See `PROVENANCE.md` there. |
| `runs/` | Run folders for `simpa run-folder` (M6): 21 real cases (20 on upstream's lib_interface cube, 1 on Night Mode's broken-hall TCR folder) and 8 stub-solver cases, each with the `expected.json` its verdict must match, observed from the M1 solvers. Generated by `tools/fixture-gen/`; see `runs/README.md`. |
| `geometry/` | Small import fixtures (STL, OBJ, PLY twins; see `geometry/PROVENANCE.md`), plus the two CLI gate fixtures `box_three_faults.simpa` and `two_boxes_interpenetrating.simpa`, regenerated from their recipes in `crates/simpa-core/tests/geometry_cli_fixtures.rs`. |
